sn35.232:1.1: Ekaṃ samayam āyasmā ca Sāriputto āyasmā ca Mahā-Koṭṭhiko Bārāṇasiyaṃ viharanti Isipatane Migadāye || || 2
sn35.232:1.2: Atha kho āyasmā Mahā-Koṭṭhiko sāyaṇhasamayam paṭisallāṇā vuṭṭhito yenāyasmā Sāriputto tenupasaṅkami || upasaṅkamitvā āyasmatā Sāriputtena saddhiṃ sammodi ||
sn35.232:1.3: sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyam vītisāretvā ekam antaṃ nisīdi || || 3 Ekam antaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā Mahā-Koṭṭhiko āyasmantam Sāriputtam etad avoca || ||
sn35.232:2.1: Kinnu kho āvuso Sāriputta cakkhu rūpānaṃ samyojanaṃ rūpā cakkhussa saṃyojanaṃ ||
sn35.232:2.2: Jivhā rasānaṃ saṃyojanaṃ rasā jivhāya saṃyojanaṃ || ||
sn35.232:2.3: Mano dhammānaṃ saṃyojanaṃ dhammā manassa saṃyojananti || || 4
sn35.232:3.1: Na kho āvuso Koṭṭhika cakkhu rūpānaṃ saṃyojanaṃ na rūpā cakkhussa saṃyojanaṃ ||
sn35.232:3.2: yañ ca tattha tad ubhayam paticca uppajjati chandarāgo taṃ tattha saṃyojanaṃ || ||
sn35.232:3.3: Na jivhā rasānaṃ saṃyojanaṃ na rasā jivhāya saṃyojanaṃ ||
sn35.232:3.4: yañ ca tattha tad ubhayam paṭicca uppajjati chandarāgo taṃ tattha saṃyojanaṃ || ||
sn35.232:3.5: Na mano dhammānaṃ saṃyojanaṃ na dhammā manassa saṃyojanaṃ ||
sn35.232:3.6: yañ ca tattha tad ubhayaṃ paṭicca uppajjati chandarāgo taṃ tattha saṃyojanaṃ || || 5
sn35.232:4.1: Seyyathāpi āvuso kāḷo ca balivaddo odāto ca balivaddo ekena damena vā yottena vā saṃyuttassu ||
sn35.232:4.3: kālo balivaddo odātassa balivaddassa saṃyojanaṃ || odāto balivaddo kāḷassa balivaddassa saṃyojananti || sammā nu kho so vadamāno vadeyyāti || ||
sn35.232:4.5: Na kho āvuso kāḷo balivaddo odātassa balivaddassa saṃyojanaṃ || na pi odāto balivaddo kāḷassa balivaddassa saṃyojanaṃ ||
sn35.232:4.6: yena ca kho ekena damena vā yottena vā saṃyuttā || taṃ tattha saṃyojanaṃ || ||
sn35.232:5.1: Evam eva kho āvuso na cakkhurūpānaṃ saṃyojanaṃ na rūpā cakkhussa saṃyojanaṃ ||
sn35.232:5.2: yañ ca tattha tad ubhayam paṭicca uppajjati chandarāgo taṃ tattha saṃyojanaṃ || pe ||
sn35.232:5.4: Na mano dhammānam saṃyojanam na dhammā manassa saṃyojanaṃ ||
sn35.232:5.5: yañ ca tattha tad ubhayam paṭicca uppajjati chandarāgo taṃ tattha saṃyojanaṃ || || 6
sn35.232:6.1: Cakkhu vā āvuso rūpānaṃ saṃyojanam abhavissa || rūpā vā cakkhussa saṃyojanaṃ || na yidaṃ brahmacariyavāso paññāyetha sammādukkhakkhayāya ||
sn35.232:6.2: yasmā ca kho āvuso na cakkhu rupānaṃ saṃyojanaṃ na rūpā cakkhussa samyojanaṃ ||
sn35.232:6.3: yañ ca tattha tad ubhayam paṭicca uppajjati chandarāgo taṃ tattha saṃyojanaṃ || tasmā brahmacariyavāso paññāyati sammādukkhayāya || pa || ||
sn35.232:7.1: Jivhā vā āvuso rasānaṃ saṃyojanam abhavissa || rasā vā jivhāya saṃyojanaṃ || nayidaṃ brahmacariyavāso paññāyetha sammādukkhakkhayāya ||
sn35.232:7.2: yasmā ca kho āvuso na jivhā rasānaṃ samyojanaṃ || na rasā jivhāya saṃyojanaṃ || yañ ca tattha tad ubhayam paṭicca uppajjati chandarāgo taṃ tattha saṃyojanaṃ || tasmā brahmacariyavāso paññāyati sammādukkhakkhayāya || pa || ||
sn35.232:8.1: Mano vā avuso dhammānaṃ saṃyojanam abhavissa || dhammā vā manassa saṃyojanaṃ || nayidam brahmacariyavāso paññāyetha sammādukkhakkhayāya ||
sn35.232:8.2: yasmā ca kho āvuso na mano dhammānaṃ saṃyojanaṃ || na dhammā manassa saṃyojanaṃ ||
sn35.232:8.3: yañ ca tattha tad ubhayam paṭicca uppajjati chandarāgo taṃ tattha saṃyojanaṃ || tasmā brahmacariyavāso paññāyati sammādukkhakkhayāya || || 7
sn35.232:9.1: Iminā petam āvuso pariyāyena veditabbaṃ || yathā na cakkhu rūpānaṃ saṃyojanaṃ || na rūpā cakkhussa saṃyojanaṃ ||
sn35.232:9.2: yañ ca tattha tad ubhayam paṭicca uppajjati chandarāgo taṃ tattha saṃyojanaṃ || pa ||
sn35.232:9.4: Na mano dhammānaṃ saṃyojanam na dhammā manassa saṃyojanaṃ ||
sn35.232:9.5: yañca tattha tad ubhayam paṭicca uppajjati chandarāgo || tam tattha saṃyojanaṃ || || 8
sn35.232:11.1: Iminā kho etam āvuso pariyāyena veditabbaṃ || yathā na cakkhu rupānaṃ saṃyojanaṃ na rūpā cakkhussa saṃyojanaṃ ||
sn35.232:11.2: yañ ca tattha tad ubhayam paṭicca uppajjati chandarāgo || taṃ tattha samyojanaṃ || ||
sn35.232:11.5: Na jivhā rasānam saṃyojanaṃ na rasā jivhāya saṃyojanaṃ ||
sn35.232:11.6: yañ ca tattha tad ubhayaṃ paṭicca uppajjati chandarāgo taṃ tattha saṃyojanam || ||
sn35.232:11.8: Na mano dhammānaṃ saṃyojanaṃ || na dhammā manassa saṃyojanaṃ ||
sn35.232:11.9: yañ ca tattha tad ubhayam paṭicca uppajjati chandarāgo taṃ tattha saṃyojananti || || 1
